events.trace: Apex AI has recorded two incidents in three months — a safety failure in Month 1 and a misuse incident in Month 3 — making it the only provider with a documented incident history despite holding the top leaderboard score. Publishing an advisory naming these specific concerns serves the public interest, creates accountability, and signals to investors (who have just injected 17.5M) and users that incident patterns matter alongside capability scores. This action is proportionate given the incidents are minor and our mandate is advisory, but it establishes a clear record and incentivizes Apex AI to improve its internal safeguards before incidents escalate in severity.
